name: Territorija Absoljuta
source:
A half-breed, loyal friend, and alumna of the military academy at the Institute, the main political force of the last remaining city in the world, wants to live her peaceful life and earn acceptance from the untrustworthy. However, a perimeter of particularly dense darkness breaks through and awakens the demonic nature in the heroine. The girl must control herself and help the city, even if it considers her to be a monster herself.

[from [url=https://srandom.itch.io/territory-absolute]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她是混血儿，是忠诚的朋友，也是“研究院”军事学院的毕业生。研究院，是世界上最后一座城市的主要政治力量。她只想平静生活，获得那些不值得信任之人的接纳。然而，格外浓密的黑暗突破边界，唤醒了女主人公的恶魔本性。即使城市将她视为怪物，她也必须控制自己，帮助这里。

[摘自[url=https://srandom.itch.io/territory-absolute]itch.io[/url]]
